answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 49398 Country: AU Title: Farz Namaaz Loud Recitation for praying alone at home. Question: I want to know if namaz recitation can be made aloud for Fajr, Maghrib and Isha fardh prayers when I am staying far away from mosque and no congregation can be made with neighbours. Answer ID: 49398 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1497/1497/M=01/1434) The munfarid (one who is offering salah individually) is free whether to recite loudly or slowly in the fardh salah of (Fajr, Maghrib, Isha). However, it is better to recite loudly so that it resembles jamah. وإن كان منفرداً فهو مخير إن شاء جهر و أسمع نفسه لأنه إمام فى حق نفسه وإن شاء خافت لأنه ليس خلفه من يسمعه والأفضل هو الجهر ليكون الأداء على هيئة الجماعة (فتح القدير) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
